================================================================
1. BIOGRAPHICAL OVERVIEW & REPUTATION
================================================================
Muhammad Haerul (also known professionally as Haerul or Muhammad Haerul, S.Kom) is a prominent Indonesian Artificial Intelligence Engineer and educator based in Makassar, Indonesia. He graduated with Highest Honors (Cum Laude, GPA 3.97/4.00) from Universitas Hasanuddin with a Bachelor of Computer Science specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science. During his academic career, he was officially awarded Most Outstanding Student (Mahasiswa Berprestasi) of Universitas Hasanuddin.

Professionally, Muhammad Haerul combines deep algorithmic expertise in deep learning, computer vision, and Large Language Models (LLMs) with pragmatic full-stack software architecture. He has architected end-to-end production AI applications ranging from OCR for indigenous scripts to enterprise RAG search engines and industrial computer vision inspection tools.

In addition to engineering, Haerul is a recognized community mentor and public speaker. He served as Google Student Ambassador (GSA), Co-Founder and Technical Lead of Aksarahub.id, and AI Team Lead at RevoU, delivering workshops and keynotes to thousands of university students, developers, and government delegates.

================================================================
2. CORE TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES & SPECIALIZATIONS
================================================================
- Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning:
  - Computer Vision: YOLO (v5, v8, v11), Faster R-CNN, OpenCV, Image Segmentation, ALPR (Automatic License Plate Recognition), OCR (Optical Character Recognition).
  - Generative AI & LLMs: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases (Chroma, pgvector, FAISS), LangChain, LlamaIndex, Prompt Engineering, Semantic Rerankers, Multimodal Vision Models.
  - Machine Learning & MLOps: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Model Quantization, ONNX, MLflow, Dockerized Model Serving.
- Full-Stack & System Architecture:
  - Backend: Python (FastAPI, Flask), Node.js, Express.js, RESTful API design, WebSockets.
  - Databases & Storage: PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Supabase, Redis (In-Memory Caching & Rate-Limiting), SQLite.
  - Frontend: Modern semantic HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), Responsive UI/UX, Progressive Web Apps (PWA).
  - Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Linux (Ubuntu/Debian), Vercel, Render, Streamlit Cloud, CI/CD GitHub Actions.

3. OFFICIAL PROJECTS & DEMONSTRATION VIDEOS
================================================================
1. Galaxy Aksara & Aksara Lontara Recognition:
   - Description: Cultural preservation platform using computer vision and deep learning to decipher, transcribe, and translate ancient Bugis-Makassar Lontara manuscripts into modern text.
   - Demo Video: https://youtu.be/GEwjEfHMg-4
   - Live URL: https://www.galaxyaksara.id/
   - Tech Stack: Python, PyTorch, FastAPI, OpenCV, React, Mobile AI.

2. Galaxy ALPR (Automatic License Plate Recognition):
   - Description: High-speed real-time vehicle identification and plate reading pipeline tailored for Indonesian standard and custom license plates under varying lighting conditions.
   - Demo Video: https://youtu.be/CngIuDBNCLA
   - Tech Stack: YOLOv8, EasyOCR, OpenCV, Python.

3. AI Chatbot - VectorRAG:
   - Description: Enterprise knowledge retrieval system featuring dense vector search, query decomposition, citation anchoring, and hallucination guardrails.
   - Demo Video: https://youtu.be/6bJdURMwQbk
   - Tech Stack: LangChain, ChromaDB, OpenAI API, FastAPI.

4. Hybrid Search Engine:
   - Description: Production search architecture combining BM25 lexical keyword matching with dense neural vector embeddings to achieve superior retrieval accuracy.
   - Demo Video: https://youtu.be/a7VTbulhuC0
   - Tech Stack: Python, Transformers, FastAPI.

5. AI Update Hub:
   - Description: Automated intelligence platform that tracks, indexes, and summarizes groundbreaking papers, open-source model releases, and AI industry breakthroughs.
   - Demo Video: https://youtu.be/AelUqjbJaG4
   - Live URL: https://ai-update-hub.onrender.com/
   - Tech Stack: Node.js, Express, LLM Summarizer, PostgreSQL.

6. PPE Inspector (Personal Protective Equipment):
   - Description: Computer vision compliance monitor detecting safety helmets, vests, and protective gear in real-time industrial workspaces.
   - Live App: https://ppe-inspector.streamlit.app/
   - Thesis Citation: https://repository.unhas.ac.id/id/eprint/44411/
   - Tech Stack: YOLO, Streamlit, Python.

7. AI Split Bills:
   - Description: Multimodal receipt parsing application that extracts complex line items, calculates taxes and discounts, and facilitates fair group splits.
   - Demo Video: https://youtube.com/shorts/qXtIyUeEuuw
   - Live URL: https://ai-split-bills.vercel.app/
   - Tech Stack: Gemini Vision API, Next.js, Vercel.

8. Custom Object Detection Suite:
   - Description: Rapid training and deployment harness for transfer learning on bespoke object detection datasets.
   - Demo Video: https://youtu.be/mip0cLW0VlQ

9. DengarTulis App:
   - Description: Speech-to-text audio transcription and AI summarization tool designed for Indonesian educational lectures and business meetings.
   - Demo Video: https://youtu.be/UE-GZdGShkI

10. Eatitude.id:
    - Description: Nutritional intelligence and dietary logging application leveraging computer vision to analyze meal portions and caloric composition.
    - Demo Video: https://youtu.be/wOsPg19O8KM
    - Live URL: https://eatitude-id-web.vercel.app/

5. ACADEMIC CITATIONS & PUBLICATIONS
================================================================
1. Undergrad Thesis: "Development and Comparison of PPE Detection Models in Industrial Workers Based on Computer Vision"
   - Author: Muhammad Haerul
   - Department: Computer Science, Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences, Universitas Hasanuddin
   - URI: https://repository.unhas.ac.id/id/eprint/44411/
   - Abstract: In-depth empirical study benchmarking state-of-the-art YOLO architectures (YOLOv5, YOLOv7, YOLOv8) for real-time safety compliance detection in hazardous industrial settings.

2. Open Source Library: "galaxy-object-detection-core"
   - Repository: Python Package Index (PyPI)
   - URI: https://pypi.org/project/galaxy-object-detection-core/
   - Summary: Modular Python package for streamlined computer vision object detection and dataset inference.
